messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #4217 (docs) needs merge timing alignment with the 1.12 feature-flag rollout. I'm worried if we merge before the FF backfill hits, the preview site will show docs for endpoints users won't have yet.

maria: which endpoints? can you paste the PR?

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217 — adds new SDK snippet for the streaming inference param `enable_kv_backfill` and a migration note. Target branch is `main` but the feature flag is gated to roll out on 2026-04-02.

sam: we have a docs cutover on 2026-04-01 right? cutoff at 23:59 UTC?

alex: correct. release window says code rollout starts 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC (canary) and FF will be backfilled across regions over 48h. My ask: can we hold the merge until FF is at 10% or change PR to land on `release/v1.12` and cherry-pick after FF?

jin: if we land on `main` preview will show the new snippet immediately. CI preview builds are off `main` — we'd expose content early.

maria: option: turn the new SDK snippet into a versioned file under `versioned_docs/version-1.12/` and hide a banner: "Feature flagged — available after 2026-04-02". That way search won't surface it in prod until we promote.

sam: that works but it's extra churn. Who's taking the refactor?

alex: I can update the PR today to move the page and add the banner. Two small changes: path and a single line front-matter `ff_gate: kv_backfill && date: 2026-04-02`.

kelly: quick check: does the docs CI (ci-bot) block merges if preview build fails?

ci-bot: preview-site check — running build for PR #4217. Current status: 1 failed job (search-index), 3 passed.

maria: search-index flake is intermittent; not related to content move. I can rerun.

ci-bot: rerun requested by maria. Build queued.

alex: also need reviewers — @maria for migration copy, @jin for SDK snippet, @sam for platform phrasing. Would like merge window of 2026-04-02 12:00 UTC if FF is at >=10%. If not, land on `release/v1.12` after cutover.

jin: I can review by EOD. If alex updates paths I'll do a focused pass on the snippet.

maria: I'll watch the preview build. If search-index passes, ok to merge to main but we still need the banner and a short note in the release notes.

sam: add a test case in the snippet showing `kv_cache_enabled: true/false` example — tiny table. I'll approve after that.

alex: adding the table now. Also adding front-matter `unreleased: true` so the site generator can hide it when needed.

ci-bot: preview-site build complete for PR #4217 — 4/4 jobs passed. Link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4217

kelly: thanks. Reminder: final merge cutoff is 2026-04-01 23:59 UTC. If merged after that and before FF rollout, product may be inconsistent for 4h. We should prefer landing on `release/v1.12` unless FF hit >=10% by 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC.

alex: noted. I'll hold merge until CI green and banner/front-matter in place. If we don't have FF at 10% by 10:00 UTC, I'll retarget to `release/v1.12` and ping here with the new PR link.

jin: thumbs up. I'll do the review after your update.

maria: ping me when you retarget. I'll update release notes and versioned TOC.

alex: updated PR: moved file to `versioned_docs/version-1.12/kv-backfill.md`, added front-matter `ff_gate: kv_backfill`, added migration note and small table. Retargeted branch -> draft `release/v1.12` branch in case we need it. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217

sam: quick read — looks good, left one nit on phrasing.

jin: approved.

maria: release notes drafted at https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/98 — mentions docs waiting on FF.

alex: CI green on the versioned page. I'll hold on merging to main. If ops confirms FF progress >=10% by 10:00 UTC 2026-04-02 I'll dance the PR back to main and merge. Otherwise we merge the release branch post-cutover. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
